scope: Retrospective full-SPARC conditional halo-template comparison; not a common-microphysics or baryon-forced field solution
sample: All 175 galaxies / 3391 rows; historical quality subset Q<3, inclination>=30deg, N>=8 reported separately.
new_analytic: Supplied second-order coalescent envelope with archived parent-compressed mode-0 dilation/fraction/scale; all shape constants fixed before fits.
mean_response: Recomputed constrained mode-1 positive mean envelope, supplied epsilon=.1, r*=.8, g0=.3; isolated-core shape, not baryon-forced equilibrium.
fit: Each halo has total mass and length fitted; fixed catalogue D,i, MLdisk=.5, MLbulge=.7. No inherited kinematic calibration.
whole_profile: Integrate halo mass to infinity; no cutoff at observed Rmax or holdout split; retain signed SPARC disk/gas/bulge force templates.
radial_protocols: All rows fitted (descriptive, no significance assigned from fitted loss)
Inner N-max(2,ceil(.2N)) fitted; all outer observations evaluated once
bounds: Length [Rmin/100,100 Rmax]; halo central potential/c^2<=.001; nonnegative halo amplitude and nonnegative total squared speed at every supplied radius.
baseline_failure: UGC01281 catalogue baryonic force is negative at two central rows. Use zero-speed continuation only for a flagged predictive-loss diagnostic, retain galaxy and rows, and report a separate physically admissible-subset sensitivity. This is not a physical GR circular solution.
inference: Equal-galaxy outer mean squared standardized residual difference; 99999 null-centered calibration-group pairs bootstrap, Ursa Major distance-method 4 grouped. Two-sided p and unsigned equivalent Z=norm.isf(p/2); sign supplies direction. Exact independent-group sign diagnostic also reported.
multiplicity: Holm correction within the four-comparison family, separately for all175 and historical131. Historical hypothesis search is not covered.
limits: Public errors omit inclination systematics and radial covariance is unavailable. Fixed-nuisance and common stellar-ML profiling sensitivities are conditional.
